 AppLovin shares rally as Q3 results top estimates, Q4 outlook beats
 Nov 04, 2026, 4:27 PM ET AppLovin Corporation (APP) Stock , APPS:CA Stock By : Soumendra Mukherjee , SA News Editor 25 Comments 
 AppLovin ( APP ) shares surged around 18% in after-hours trading on Wednesday after the advertising technology company reported third-quarter results that topped Bloomberg estimates and issued fourth-quarter guidance above expectations.
 The company posted revenue of $2.18 billion, up 55% year-over-year, beating the Bloomberg consensus estimate
